description: This file is a fuzzing test for the HttpServer component in the Chromium project, designed to test server behavior with various inputs using fuzzing techniques.

classes.name: WaitTillHttpCloseDelegate
classes.description: A delegate class for HttpServer that manages connection and message handling during fuzz testing, including actions like accepting, replying, and closing connections based on fuzzed input.

methods.name: set_server
methods.description: Sets the server instance that the delegate will operate on.

methods.name: OnConnect
methods.description: Handles new connection events, closing the connection if not accepted.

methods.name: OnHttpRequest
methods.description: Handles incoming HTTP requests, optionally replying with a 200 response.

methods.name: OnWebSocketRequest
methods.description: Handles WebSocket upgrade requests, accepting or closing based on flags.

methods.name: OnWebSocketMessage
methods.description: Handles messages over WebSocket, optionally replying.

methods.name: OnClose
methods.description: Handles connection closure, triggers the completion callback.
